description: Batch operations on content entries. All operations are auto-committed to git. DRY RUN (dry_run:true): runs the whole operation in a throwaway worktree and reports exactly what would change — nothing is committed and no branch survives. Recommended workflow: preview with dry_run:true, review the counts, then call again to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true for delete_entries (not needed while dry_run:true — a preview deletes nothing)

dry_run.description: Preview mode: perform the operation in a throwaway worktree and report what would change, committing nothing. Defaults to false so existing callers keep executing.

entry_ids.description: Entry IDs for update_status (collection models) or delete_entries

locale.description: Scope update_status to a single locale (i18n models only; defaults to every supported locale)

slugs.description: Document slugs for update_status (document models) — a document is addressed by slug, the same identity contentrain_content_save uses, not by entry ID

name: contentrain_bulk
